name: Togetherness
overview: Scripture reveals that togetherness is both a blessing and a command rooted in God’s design for community and mutual support. Believers are called to gather in His name, where Christ promises His presence among them, fostering unity and spiritual strength. Friendship and fellowship are portrayed as vital for growth and encouragement, as friends sharpen one another and demonstrate love that reflects Christ’s own love. Worship, mutual care, and loving one another are foundational expressions of this togetherness, strengthening both individual faith and collective labor.
